There is no `SpacingToken` component in the PLUS design system — spacing values are design tokens (CSS variables), not a UI component, so there is nothing to implement via `component_implement`. 

In PLUS, spacing is handled through semantic CSS custom properties (such as `--size-card-gap-md`, `--size-element-pad-x-sm`, `--size-section-gap-lg`) rather than a wrapper component. If you are looking to style a layout, you apply those tokens directly in CSS/SCSS or use structural layout components like [Card](https://github.com/BilLogic/plus-uno/tree/main/design-system/src/components/layout-and-structure/Card) or [Divider](https://github.com/BilLogic/plus-uno/tree/main/design-system/src/components/layout-and-structure/Divider).

If you are proposing a brand-new component for the library, it needs a Notion PRD and design review first before anything can be built (and `component_implement` also requires an approved PRD in hand).
